summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) filed a Form 6-K notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting on September 30, 2026, to approve a partial spin-off (Phase 2) of its Wholesale Fiber Connectivity business into PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF), a 99.99%-owned subsidiary. The spin-off is a continuation of Phase 1 approved December 12, 2025. Post-transaction, Telkom's stake in TIF rises to 99.9999999%, with PT Multimedia Nusantara holding 0.0000001%. No changes to existing shareholder stakes. Agenda 2 covers management changes. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory timelines.
